record_title: Certified sparse-matvec convexification for proximal nonconvex QP
provenance: Exact analysis of the smallest-eigenvalue shift used to convexify proximal nonconvex-QP subproblems in arXiv:2609.19557v1, together with a comparison-matrix certificate using weighted Gershgorin and Collatz-Wielandt refinement.
limitations: The finite-Lanczos obstruction applies to an ordinary Ritz estimate without an independent certified lower-bound safeguard; it does not establish that reported PDNQP experiments under-regularized. The comparison-matrix certificate can be conservative outside sign-switchable Z-matrix structure, and rigorous floating-point certification needs rounding control or an explicit safety allowance. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
